name: synthetic-record-transaction-duplicate
description: The same sale sent twice under one invoiceId. HTTP 200, success:false, duplicate:true, and the commission ids it matched — the de-duplication that stops a retry from paying an affiliate a second time. Authored from the GrowSurf REST v2 (2.0.0) response shape, verified field for field against a live deployment on 2026-09-22; the identities are GrowSurf's own published example values.

body.message: Sale already recorded for identifiers: invoiceId. Matching commission IDs: jy6kl1
